Mon2: My parents weren't unkind people. They just had a very particular picture of what a sensible life should look like.#$b#A steady job, tidy clothes, no splinters in your hands. I tried it for a while. Then I found myself repairing a chair instead of listening to the lecture.$1
Mon4: The first thing I ever built that I was genuinely proud of was a little wooden box. The lid didn't fit, one corner was crooked, and it smelled strongly of glue...#$b#I kept it for years. I suppose I was already a carpenter. I just hadn't admitted it yet.$h
Mon8: People sometimes think leaving a marriage means you stop caring about the family you built. That's never how it worked for me.#$b#Sebastian and Maru are still my children. Nothing about a change of address can undo that.$2
Tue2: Carpentry is funny. People see the finished table and think the work was all cutting and hammering.#$b#Most of it is measuring twice, making a mistake anyway, and refusing to let the mistake win.$h
Tue6: I used to draw little house plans in the margins of my schoolbooks. Nothing practical, just rooms with huge windows and impossible staircases.#$b#My teachers thought I was distracted. They weren't entirely wrong.$1
Tue10: You know what I like about talking with you? I don't feel as though I have to make every sentence useful.#$b#Sometimes it's nice to say something silly and let it sit there.$6
Wed4: Maru was always curious about how things worked. She'd stand beside my workbench and ask twelve questions before I'd finished answering the first one.#$b#I used to pretend to be annoyed. I wasn't. I loved that little spark in her.$h
Wed8: Sebastian once asked me to build a desk with a hidden compartment for his computer cables.#$b#I made it exactly as he wanted, then added a small extra shelf. He noticed immediately, of course. He notices everything when it comes to his computer.$1
Thu4: I don't think I ever told you why I like working with wood so much.#$b#A tree takes years to grow. Then someone cuts it, shapes it, sands it, and gives it another purpose. There's something hopeful in that.$h
Thu8: After the separation, I kept telling myself I was fine because I was busy. Work, errands, another project, then another.#$b#It took me a while to understand that being occupied isn't quite the same thing as being okay.$2
Fri2: Veronica and I have very different ways of solving problems. She likes to take things apart until she understands every piece. I usually stare at the problem, make a sketch, and start building.#$b#Somehow, between the two of us, things get done.$1
Fri6: I miss the ordinary noises of the old house sometimes. Maru tinkering, Sebastian's music downstairs, someone opening the fridge for the third time in ten minutes.#$b#I don't miss every part of that life... but I do miss those little sounds.$2
Fri10: I used to think starting over meant becoming a completely different person.#$b#Now I think it means keeping the parts of yourself worth keeping, and finally making room for the rest.$6
Sat2: I have a confession. I once stayed up far too late playing a game because I wanted to see whether I could solve it without looking up a guide.#$b#I did solve it. At sunrise. My neck was stiff for two days, but I won.$h
Sun4: Leah has been a wonderful friend to me. We can spend an entire afternoon working on separate projects without feeling the need to fill every quiet moment.#$b#It's a rare kind of comfort. I'm lucky to have found it.$1
Sun8: When I was younger, I thought family meant everyone living under one roof and eating at the same table.#$b#I've learned that it can be messier than that. People move, people change, people need space... and they can still belong to one another.$2
spring_Tue: Spring makes me want to build something with the windows open. Fresh air, birds outside, and absolutely no reason to rush. That's my kind of workday.$h
summer_Wed: Summer is when every project seems possible. Then the afternoon heat arrives and reminds me that I'm not made of hardwood.$2

winter_Sun: Winter makes me nostalgic. I remember sitting with the children while the snow came down, trying to convince them that hot cocoa counts as a balanced meal if you add enough marshmallows.$h
